title: Ben Affleck's Thriller Joins Netflix Soon
text:
Ben Affleck's gripping thriller is set to join Netflix's library soon. The movie, which has been officially available to stream on the platform, follows the story of a husband who is accused of killing his wife after she suddenly disappeared.
A gripping thriller starring Ben Affleck is set to join Netflix soon. The movie, which has been officially available to stream on the platform, follows the story of a husband who is accused of killing his wife after she suddenly disappeared.
The cast includes Rosamund Pike as Amy, Neil Patrick Harris as Desi, Tyler Perry as Tanner, Carrie Coon as Margo, Kim Dickens as Detective Rhonda Boney, Emily Ratajkowski as Andie, Boyd Holbrook as Jeff, and more. The film was directed by David Fincher, with Gillian Flynn writing the screenplay. It was based on Flynn's 2012 novel of the same name. Producers were Reese Witherspoon, Arnon Milchan, Joshua Donen, and Ceán Chaffin.
It was executive-produced by Leslie Dixon and Bruna Papandrea. The movie grossed over $370 million at the global box office. For her performance, Pike received a Golden Globe nomination and an Oscar nomination for Best Actress. The movie's official synopsis reads: In Carthage, Mo.
, former New York-based writer Nick Dunne and his glamorous wife Amy present a portrait of a blissful marriage to the public; when Amy goes missing on the couple's fifth wedding anniversary, Nick becomes the prime suspect in her disappearance; the resulting police pressure and media frenzy cause the Dunnes' image of a happy union to crumble, leading to tantalizing questions about who Nick and Amy truly are. The movie's reception was positive, with a Certified Fresh score of 88% on Rotten Tomatoes, based on 375 reviews.
The movie's success can be attributed to its well-crafted storyline, strong performances, and the direction of David Fincher. The movie's cast, which includes Ben Affleck and Rosamund Pike, delivered impressive performances that added depth to the story. The movie's themes of marriage, media pressure, and the complexities of human relationships are thought-provoking and relatable. Overall, the movie is a gripping thriller that keeps viewers engaged and invested in the story.
The movie's addition to Netflix's library is a welcome one, and fans of the thriller genre are sure to enjoy it. The movie's success is a testament to the power of storytelling and the impact it can have on audiences. With its positive reception and strong performances, the movie is a must-watch for fans of the thriller genre
